meta.title: ICT explain／compare 句式卡
meta.subject: DSE ict
meta.note: 原編答題句式，不是考評局評卷參考的原文。

cards.title: Explaining a device choice
cards.phrase: [Device] suits this case because [need from the question]. It [function], so [outcome for the users or the school].
cards.tips: Quote the numbers or distances in the question so the reason is tied to the case, not to a generic list.

cards.title: Comparing LAN and WAN
cards.phrase: Both connect hosts and allow sharing; a LAN covers one site over a short distance, whereas a WAN links separate sites over long distances.
cards.tips: Give one similarity and one difference at least, and use both / whereas to make the comparison explicit.

cards.title: Validation and verification
cards.phrase: Validation checks that data is sensible in form, for example a valid date format; verification checks that the data was entered or copied correctly.
cards.tips: Give one concrete example of each, such as rejecting an impossible age and re-entering a mark twice.

cards.title: Lossy and lossless compression
cards.phrase: Lossy compression discards detail so the file is smaller but cannot be restored exactly; lossless compression rebuilds the original bits exactly.
cards.tips: Name a typical format for each, such as JPEG for lossy and PNG or ZIP for lossless.

cards.title: Threat and control
cards.phrase: The threat is [X]; a suitable control is [Y] because it [mechanism that reduces the risk].
cards.tips: Cover more than one layer, a technical control and a habit, so the answer shows defence in depth.

cards.title: Describing a dry run
cards.phrase: Trace: columns for [variables]; at step n, [variable] becomes [value]; the output is [value or text].
cards.tips: Update a cell only on the step that assigns to it, and state the output the algorithm actually produces.

cards.title: Personal data and purpose limitation
cards.phrase: Collect only [fields] that the task needs for [purpose], store them securely, and do not reuse them for another purpose without a basis.
cards.tips: Keep the wording conservative and general, and refer to the purpose rather than to a specific statute.

cards.title: Planning exam time
cards.phrase: Read the command word, underline the facts in the case, plan one point per mark, then check the units, formula and rounding.
cards.tips: The verb decides the depth; check units and any required rounding before moving on.
